questions.question: If 19 June 2001 is Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 21 August 2009?
questions.solution: Given: 19 June 2001 is **Tuesday**. Now, 2001 to 2009 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year). And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year. So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days, And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10. 10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

questions.question: In a month of 29 days, the second Thursday falls on the 13th day of the month. What day of the week will be the second last day of the month?
questions.solution:
Given: 13th February of the month = Thursday. (As, 29 days month is February)

So, second last day of the month means 28th February,

And, days between 13th February to 28th February - 15 days.

And, 15 days = 15/7 = 2 week and **1 odd day**.

Then, the second last day of the month will be: Thursday + 1 = **Friday**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+' and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘-' and '÷’ are interchanged?

105 - 15 ÷ 13 + 3 × 27 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 105 - 15 ÷ 13 + 3 × 27 = ? 

Now, if ‘+' and ‘×‘ and ‘-' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ __**105 ÷ 15**__ - 13 × 3 + 27 = ? 

⇒ 7 - __**13 **____**×**____** 3**__ + 27 = ? 

⇒ __**7**__ - 39 __**+ 27**__ = ? 

⇒ __**34** - 39__ = **-5**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: 11 is related to 1210 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 13 is related to 1690. To which of the following is 17 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:

Logic: (1st number)2 × 10 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 11 is related to 1210

⇒ (11)2 × 10

⇒ 121 × 10 = 1210.

For, 13 is related to 1690

⇒ (13)2 × 10

⇒ 169 × 10 = 1690.

Similarly, for **17 related to**

**⇒ (17)2 × 10**

**⇒ 289 × 10 = 2890.**

So, **17 related to 2890**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
If ‘A’ stands for '÷', 'B’ stands for '×’, 'C’ stands for '+' and 'D’ stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark ‘?' in the following equation?

1024 A 32 B 11 D 57 C 121 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 1024 A 32 B 11 D 57 C 121 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**1024 ÷ 32**__ × 11 - 57 + 121 = ?

⇒ __**32 × 11**__ - 57 + 121 = ?

⇒ __**352**__ - 57 __**+ 121**__ = ?

⇒ __473** - 57**__ = **416**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 4".
